summary: Iteration 31 - Knowledge Base System Testing. All 31 backend tests passed. All frontend tests passed. Knowledge Base feature fully functional with 30 trading terms, Glossary page with search/filters, and InfoTooltip components integrated across Strategy Builder, BuilderPage, and BacktestPage.

BACKEND: GET /api/v1/knowledge/category/risk_management returns 8 risk management terms
BACKEND: GET /api/v1/knowledge/category/general returns 7 general concept terms
BACKEND: All 30 terms have required fields (term_id, term, category, short_description, example)
BACKEND: No MongoDB _id fields in responses
BACKEND: Terms sorted alphabetically by term_id

BACKEND: Specific terms exist with correct categories (rsi, sma, ema, macd, stochastic, adx, atr, bollinger, supertrend, vwap, stop_loss, target_profit, trailing_sl, time_exit, position_sizing, win_rate, max_drawdown, sharpe_ratio, profit_factor, backtest)
FRONTEND: Glossary link visible in sidebar navigation with GraduationCap icon
FRONTEND: /glossary page loads with all 30 terms
FRONTEND: Glossary search functionality works (tested with 'RSI')
FRONTEND: Glossary category filters work (All: 30, Indicators: 15, Risk Management: 8, General Concepts: 7)
FRONTEND: InfoTooltip icons visible on BacktestPage metric cards (win_rate, max_drawdown, sharpe_ratio, profit_factor)

InfoTooltip component uses global caching for knowledge base data - efficient implementation

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 31 tested the Knowledge Base feature. All features working: (1) GET /api/v1/knowledge returns 30 trading terms with proper structure. (2) GET /api/v1/knowledge/{term_id} returns individual term details. (3) GET /api/v1/knowledge/category/{category} filters by category. (4) Glossary page at /glossary shows all terms with search and category filters. (5) Glossary link in sidebar navigation with GraduationCap icon. (6) InfoTooltip component fetches and caches all terms globally. (7) InfoTooltip icons visible on BacktestPage metrics (win_rate, max_drawdown, sharpe_ratio, profit_factor). (8) InfoTooltip icons visible in BuilderPage RiskEditor (stop_loss, target_profit, trailing_sl, time_exit). Note: StrategyBuilder.js has InfoTooltip integration but is not used in current UI flow.
